title: Luscious Australian Fish Poke
description: A funky and juicy Australian dish featuring sashimi-cut fish and a unique twist with ice cream, this romantic meal is perfect for special occasions, and is nut-free-friendly for added convenience.

ingredients.name: sashimi-grade tuna
ingredients.notes: fresh and frozen to safe temperature

instructions: Cut the sashimi-grade tuna into small cubes and place in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, lemon juice, honey, and sesame oil to make the marinade.
Pour the marinade over the tuna and toss to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, scoop the vanilla ice cream into balls and place on top of the tuna.
Garnish with thinly sliced pickled ginger and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
